systems.platform: Tier 3 data centre with a backup site and a disaster recovery site
systems.tiers: Government and private sector ICT hosting; banks and mobile providers use it at a fee

note: The 2019 statement describes a Tier 3 national data centre that consolidated government hosting and 52 websites deployed to it, but states no hosting or cloud policy or rule; a data centre alone is not a policy, so no fact.
